title: Press_Anchor re-gate drops the chord's swallow reset when ESC shares the frame — release click-select diverges from the pre-change handle_input
detail: Same-frame ESC+right+left chord: the old chord reset press_swallowed after the ESC block (false, so a near release click-selects); the re-gate drops Press_Anchor, the executor Cancel's swallow=true stands, the release no-ops. Selection state diverges from pre-change behavior.
recommended_fix: Emit Press_Anchor whenever a Cancel is actually queued: gate on `has_left && (esc_pressed || placing_eff >= 0)` — esc_pressed covers the ESC cancel/deselect branches; drop the redundant `!esc_cancelled`.
